body:
Implement Wave 2 T-P18 from .adlc/specs/enhancement-resolution-plan.md:

1. Atomic writes onto @adlc/core:
   - packages/fleet/lib/status.mjs: use writeFileAtomic from @adlc/core in saveStatus.
   - packages/backlog-groom/lib/io.mjs: default saveCache/saveLedger to writeFileAtomic and accept 40-64 hex SHA-1/SHA-256 OIDs in resolveRemoteBaseSha.
   - packages/context-handoff/lib/rollback.mjs: use writeFileAtomic when io.fs.writeFileSync is not injected.

2. flail-detector:
   - packages/flail-detector/lib/parse-log.mjs: exclude read-only tools (Read/Grep/Glob/LS/view_file/grep_search/find_by_name/list_dir) from synthetic Writing lines in extractFileTargets, and support JSON array transcripts.
   - packages/flail-detector/lib/signals.mjs: normalize repo-relative paths (cwd-relative, POSIX slashes, strip leading ./) in detectScopeViolations and detectEditChurn.
   - packages/flail-detector/bin/flail-detector.mjs: bounded tail reading (16 MiB cap) while preserving true file byte count for size signal, and forward cwd to analyze.
   - Add packages/flail-detector/test/relative-scope.test.mjs.

3. build-gate:
   - packages/build-gate/lib/risk.mjs: symmetric touchesAny (globMatch(g, p) || globMatch(p, g)) and include .adlc/manifest.d/** in MANIFEST_PATHS.
   - packages/build-gate/bin/build-gate.mjs: open --transcript with O_NOFOLLOW + fstatSync(fd).isFile() verification (refusing FIFOs/symlinks), read directly from fd up to MAX_ACTIVE_CONTEXT_BYTES, update stale 256 KiB comment, and rebuild Cursor bundles.
   - Add packages/build-gate/test/glob-order-and-fifo.test.mjs.

4. consensus-fix:
   - packages/consensus-fix/lib/snapshot.mjs: compute all hunks before writing in applyChanges so a failed hunk never leaves earlier files half-written.
   - packages/consensus-fix/lib/runner.mjs: add timeoutMs and maxBuffer bounds in runCommand.
   - packages/consensus-fix/lib/agreement.mjs: allow a single passing candidate (groups.size <= 1) to win in isAllDivergent when peers fail tests.

5. context-handoff:
   - packages/context-handoff/lib/supervise-runtime.mjs: kill negative process group (-child.pid) when detached.
   - packages/context-handoff/lib/supervise.mjs: cap continuations via maxContinuations (default 20).
   - packages/context-handoff/lib/adapter.mjs: preserve one-shot bypass grants when no deny would fire (including read-only probes).

Verification:
npm run build:cursor-mcp && node --test packages/flail-detector/test/*.test.mjs packages/build-gate/test/*.test.mjs packages/consensus-fix/test/*.test.mjs packages/context-handoff/test/*.test.mjs packages/backlog-groom/test/*.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/status.test.mjs scripts/test/ticket-store-boundary.test.mjs
title: Wave 2 T-P18 (R4 + R7 + C1 + C2 + C3): Migrate atomic writes/locks and fix runtime bugs in flail-detector, build-gate, consensus-fix, context-handoff, and backlog-groom
